evidence: Bug is about the Inspector's computed panel OutputParser rendering an empty button for shape-outside, a DevTools Inspector issue.

The bug concerns the address bar trust panel icon (Firefox::Address Bar and site identity UI), owned by Search Next Generation, with the Unified Trust Panel feature thought to be driven by the privacy/anti-tracking panel.
Crash reporter client build-id derivation most plausibly owned by Toolkit::Crash Reporting under Telemetry.
The heap use-after-free occurs in nsAnimationManager::DoUpdateAnimations, which is owned by the Layout team per the CSS Animations component.
The bug is about scroll snap selection verification tests involving axes 'both', which belongs to Core::Panning and Zooming (APZ), owned by the Layout team.
Split view and tab group behavior in collapsed groups points to Firefox::Tabbed Browser components owned by Frontend.
The report mentions the urlbar read-only state in taskbar tabs, pointing to the address bar component owned by Search Next Generation.
The crash is in a Windows KeyWatcher destructor misusing Win32 handle APIs (CloseHandle vs RegisterWaitForSingleObject/UnregisterWait), which is platform Windows integration code.
The bug concerns default search engine telemetry probes (search.engine.default.*), owned by the Search Next Generation team.
Pointer lock mouse event coordinates and synthesized recentering event involve DOM input event handling (UI Events & Focus Handling in DOM Core) and IPC between content and parent processes.
Bug is about RTL margin on .urlbar-input-box, part of the address bar UI owned by Firefox::Address Bar under Search Next Generation.
Heap-use-after-free in IndexedDB ActorsParent.cpp IPC handler points to Core::Storage IndexedDB and IPC validation, owned by DOM LWS.
Build failure mentioning libdl and OpenBSD platform integration points to OS-level platform support rather than web content code.
The assertion fires inside mozilla::net::CookieService::Init() in netwerk/cookie/CookieService.cpp, pointing to the networking/CookieService component.
Stack shows CDMInformation and UtilityMediaServiceChild::GetKeySystemCapabilities in EME/CDM code path, pointing to Media's GMP/CDM components.
Font loading from omni.ja via gfx's AppendFacesFromOmnijarEntry and nsZipCursor points to the GFX text/font stack.
Bug concerns Firefox application settings UI ('Settings UI'/'Preferences') and rows without actions, owned by Frontend.
The report only references reverting another bug's fix without describing any component or symptom, so no team can be confidently identified.

Report describes a focus management failure that impacts screen reader users, directly implicating accessibility, while the trust panel/site identity UI falls under privacy-facing frontend components.

The assertion messages ('Column set should be complete', 'flex container', 'frame tree not empty') and the crash involving frame reflow at a specific URL point to layout fragmentation bugs owned by the Layout team.
The test failure is in customizable UI and involves the FxA account button, which is part of the browser toolbar/messaging system owned by Frontend or Messaging teams.
The bug involves a focus test using the accessibility-related DOMMenuItemActive event and FocusManager, which relates to Core::Disability Access APIs owned by Accessibility.
Bug is in nsWindowWatcher opening popup windows with full chrome, part of window management (Frontend/Core::Window Management).
Bug is in browser/components/urlbar/UrlbarParentController and Firefox::Address Bar (owned by Search Next Generation), with JSWindowActor message-path issues.
The report concerns the Firefox "Server Not Found" error page's UI text and "Learn More" link, which is owned by the Toolkit::Error Pages component under the Frontend team.
The bug concerns a CSS border in the notificationbox and RDM (Responsive Design Mode) toolbar UI, which is front-end browser chrome styling rather than layout engine or DevTools tooling.

The bug is in nsPipeInputStream cloning within XPCOM pipes used by networking/streams (Response.body, Blob.stream, HTTP channels), pointing to Core::Networking (Necko) as the owner of nsPipe/nsICloneableInputStream.
Security warnings card with password manager disabled reset button is a Settings UI (about:preferences) issue owned by Frontend.
Bug concerns SearchWidgetTracker and search-container widget placement removal, which belongs to Firefox::Search (Search Next Generation).
The DAMP browser-toolbox/inspector-ready performance regression points at the DevTools toolbox's inspector, owned by DevTools.
The favicon.ico request is made without the session cookies/credentials, causing a 401, which points to cookie or credential handling for subresources like favicons.

The bug is in a bundled SVG illustration asset selected by net-error-card.mjs and used by error pages, which is front-end browser UI asset territory, though it could also be owned by Networking for net error pages.
The bug is a use-after-munmap in DrawTargetWebgl Canvas2D/WebGL code under Core::Graphics (GFX).
Bug concerns IPC ParamTraits deserialization of WidgetEvent in widget/nsGUIEventIPC.h, which belongs to Core::IPC under OS Integration.
Bug is in SERPCategorization.sys.mjs which handles search result categorization in the address bar/search domain, owned by Search Next Generation (Firefox::Address Bar/Search).
Leak involves WebBrowserPersistDocumentChild IPC actor tied to a content Document, pointing to DOM/IPC content-process actors (DOM: Content Processes / IPC).
Bug is about WebAssembly memory bounds check in the JS engine (Core::JavaScript: WebAssembly), which the Javascript team owns.
Tab notes are a tab strip feature, mapping to Firefox::Tabbed Browser which is owned by the Search Next Generation team.
Build system error about missing generated header but no clear owner among teams; CI/build tooling is closest match.
Crash originates in SpiderMonkey's Intl.Collator string collation path (js::intl::CompareStrings), owned by the Javascript team.
The tracking panel and shield icon UI belongs to Firefox::Protections UI, owned by Privacy Engineering.
Bug is about a VPN status checkbox rendered abnormally large in the browser overflow menu UI, pointing to front-end menu/widget code.
The bug report is too vague, only referencing a bug number and Thunderbird without describing the actual issue.
Bug is in js/src/wasm/WasmPI.cpp and WasmModule.cpp involving WebAssembly.promising, which is owned by the Javascript team (Core::JavaScript: WebAssembly).
The bug is in servo's rule cache for computed styles, which is part of the style system owned by Layout.
New WPT failures in /svg/animations/ animateMotion path tests point to the Core::SVG component owned by Layout.
IPDL-related crash points to Core::IPC, owned by OS Integration.
Nova spotlights template is part of the Messaging System's user-interrupting message templates.
Crash occurs in a graphics platform font API (gfxAndroidPlatform IsFontAPIDisabled / ASystemFontIterator), matching the GFX team's graphics components.
Scrolling failure inside nested tab content, mobile-only, points to scroll/overflow handling in Layout (Core::Layout: Scrolling and Overflow).
Bug is in XULButtonAccessible::AreItemsOperable, a file under accessible/xul, so the Accessibility component owns the fix.
Scroll and paint performance regressions on macOS with WebRender enabled point to the graphics/compositing subsystem (GFX), though talos alert ownership is ambiguous.

Buttons in the credit-card/address/password autofill doorhanger (a form autofill/password manager UI) are missing borders, pointing at the Credential Management team that owns doorhangers and their styling.
Slow Metal shader cache / ANGLE compilation for WebGL is handled by the Graphics (GFX) team.
The bug mentions 'media-triage-bot' and 'Media+AI=padenot', pointing to the media triage automation and requiring an appropriate component under Media.
The bug concerns JXL (JPEG XL) decoding performance, which falls under image decoding, handled by the Media team in Core::Graphics: ImageLib.
Build bustage in masm.callWithABI with jit::InitBaselineFrameForOsr points to the JavaScript Engine JIT baseline compiler.
WebRTC mDNS candidate obfuscation is part of the WebRTC networking stack (mDNS ICE candidates), owned by Media through Core::WebRTC: Networking.
The bug is a heap overflow in ANGLE's copyimage.cpp triggered via WebGL readPixels, which belongs to GFX's ANGLE/WebGL components.
HappyEyeballs and nsSocketTransport are part of Necko networking code.
RemoteMediaDataEncoderChild and RemoteCDMChild are media GMP/CDM actors, pointing to the Media team.
Leak in widget/gtk/nsGtkKeyUtils.cpp KeymapWrapper maps to Core::Widget: Gtk, owned by OS Integration.
FOG (Firefox on Glean) initialization and Services.fog are owned by Telemetry, and the crash occurs in telemetry initialization during shutdown.
window.open() with a chrome:// URI resizing its parent window points to DOM: Window and Location handling within DOM Core.
Crash in nsTextFrame::GetSelectionDetails within layout/generic text frame code points to Layout ownership.
Crash stack in nsIFrame::CorrectStyleParentFrame and RestyleManager's first-line reparenting points to Core::Layout style/frame code.
Site fails to load/redirect after update while Chrome works, pointing to a Firefox networking/connection handling regression.
Bug describes a fetch from a dedicated worker not being intercepted by a service worker, implicating service worker fetch interception code in Core::DOM: Service Workers (DOM LWS).
Offline mode and neterror handling involve the networking component, with the menu checkbox mis-sync pointing to frontend.
Bug is in widget/cocoa (Core::Widget: Cocoa), which is owned by OS Integration.
The report mentions only generic 'state UI design' inconsistencies inconsistent with a Figma spec, with no component clues, so routing is ambiguous.
ConfirmationHint is a browser front-end UI widget in browser/base/content, owned by the Frontend team.
Screen reader (NVDA) cannot announce a label for the toggle in the Search preferences reorderable list, indicating an accessible name/role issue owned by the Accessibility team.
PDF text selection visibility tied to backdrop-filter fallback and graphics driver blocklisting points to graphics rendering code.
Crash occurs in WebRender source file gfx/wr/webrender/src/prepare.rs, which belongs to the GFX team's Core::Graphics: WebRender component.
The bug hinges on a dismissed CFR (Contextual Feature Recommender) and subsequent toolbar/panel state, which is owned by the Firefox Messaging System team.
URL fragment leakage in Reporting API reports involves native content security and data exposure, matching Core::DOM: Security under Security Engineering.
CSS Typed OM style property map test for animation-duration computed value points to CSS style system/DOM CSS Object Model owned by Layout.
The crash is in dom/file/MutableBlobStorage.cpp, which falls under Core::DOM: File owned by DOM LWS, though the IPDL actor lifecycle details also touch OS Integration's IPC component.
The bug is about the HTML parser's adoption agency algorithm producing an incorrect DOM tree, which is owned by Core::DOM: HTML Parser under DOM Core.
The warning comes from widget/gtk/ScreenHelperGTK.cpp, which is owned by the OS Integration team's Core::Widget: Gtk component.
ASan leak in PrefWrapper::GetStringValue(), a preferences backend API used by Telemetry code.
It's a browser-chrome mochitest failure, so likely a test-harness/CI issue rather than a product code bug.
Backtrace shows a crash in js::wasm::TypeContext::indexOf within js/src/wasm/WasmTypeDef.h and Ion/Wasm code generation, owned by Core::JavaScript: WebAssembly.
Bug is about a messaging_system impression telemetry event with undefined message_id from a Spotlight/Tab Groups Promo, which is owned by the Messaging System team.
The ASan heap-use-after-free stack trace points into gfx/harfbuzz font code (hb-ot-metrics, hb-ot-font) used by gfxFont::GetBaseline, which is owned by the GFX team.
The report mentions an infinite loop in querySelector, a DOM API, pointing to DOM Core as the primary owner.
Print preview shows black-and-white but the printer outputs color, pointing at print output rendering (Core::Printing: Output under Layout).
Report concerns searchbar TabToSearch behavior, which belongs to Firefox::Address Bar / Firefox::Search owned by Search Next Generation.
HTTP/2 RST_STREAM handling in Http2Session.cpp mapping to NS_ERROR_NET_RESET is Necko/Networking code, though the surface symptom is a mislabeled secure-connection error.
The bug is about hiding 'Clear Data' in a private browsing panel, which belongs to privacy-related UI components.
Crash is in nsJARChannel/nsJARProtocolHandler (Necko jar protocol handler) called via fetch, owned by Networking.
Screen reader not reading a link in the About Firefox window points to an accessibility issue with the platform accessibility tree or UI markup.
Crash stack shows hwinference SpeechRecognitionParent in dom/media/webspeech/recognition, placing the fault in Media's Web Speech/audio components.
Profile selection/startup system and profiles.ini handling point to Toolkit::Startup and Profile System under OS Integration.
Bug involves tab group and split view UI interaction, owned by Firefox::Tabbed Browser components under Frontend.
The bug is in RTCDTMFSender (a WebRTC component), which falls under the Media team's ownership.
Bug is about session history entries and titles after POST/replaceState redirects, which falls under history/session restore ownership in Search Next Generation's Places component.
The failing test is a wasm off-thread compilation test (dom/base/test/test_wasm_offthread_compile.html), and WebAssembly compilation is owned by the JavaScript engine team.
